kaps_punt: GEEN KABV-inhoudstrepie. Hierdie les is die video se inleiding en dien KABV se afdeling 2.5 - 2.5.2 se nota oor die ontwikkeling van karteringsvaardighede en 2.5.3 se doelwit van leerders wat kaarte kan trek en gebruik.

items.bewering: Jy kan die pad in woorde beskryf, of jy kan 'n kaart teken.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Location' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/location/): relative location is a description of how a place is related to other places, given in words (e.g. 'about 15 blocks from Central Park'); National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/): maps use lines, colours, symbols and words to show where things are. Both ways of giving a location are real.

items.bewering: 'n Kaart is 'n verkleinde tekening wat van bo af wys waar dinge in 'n plek lê.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/): 'a symbolic representation of selected characteristics of a place, usually drawn on a flat surface' and 'of the arrangement of features in an area'; Afrikaanse Wikipedia, 'Kaart' (https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaart): 'n gemodelleerde weergawe van die aardoppervlak, gewoonlik op 'n skaal geteken (bv. 1:25 000); Esri GIS Dictionary, 'planimetric map' (https://support.esri.com/en-us/gis-dictionary/planimetric-map) and Wikipedia 'Planimetrics': map features are shown by horizontal position, as seen from the air. 'Verkleinde', 'van bo af' and 'waar dinge lê' each map onto scale, plan view and arrangement. 'Tekening' is a fair Grade 4 simplification of 'representation'.

items.bewering: Die tekening wys die dorp van bo af en nie van die kant af nie.
items.bron: Esri GIS Dictionary, 'planimetric map' (https://support.esri.com/en-us/gis-dictionary/planimetric-map): a map shows x,y (horizontal) positions; Wikipedia, 'Planimetrics' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Planimetrics): roads, building footprints and rivers are represented on two-dimensional maps as they are seen from the air. Plan view against side view is the standard distinction. Pictorial or oblique tourist maps exist, but the sentence describes the town map in the lesson's own example, and for that it holds.

items.bewering: Die kaart is baie kleiner as die dorp self.
items.bron: Afrikaanse Wikipedia, 'Kaart' (https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaart): maps are drawn to a scale such as 1:25 000; National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/), section on scale. A town map at any usable scale is far smaller than the town.

items.bewering: Daar is nie plek vir alles wat in die dorp is nie. Die mense wat 'n kaart maak, kies daarom wat hulle daarop wys.
items.bron: ITC (University of Twente) Living Textbook, 'Cartographic generalization' (https://ltb.itc.utwente.nl/659/concept/174062): selection decides which features are included or left out, based on scale, purpose and relevance; National Geographic Education, 'Map': a map shows 'selected characteristics of a place'. The 'daarom' gives lack of space as the reason. That is a true reason but not the only one, because purpose matters too. The lesson's third block carries purpose ('hulle wys nie almal dieselfde ding nie'), so the picture as a whole is not false.

items.bewering: 'n Kaart beantwoord drie van die vrae wat 'n mens dikwels oor 'n plek het. Die eerste vraag is waar die plek lê wat jy soek.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/): maps 'show where things are'; grids let people reference locations ('trail begins at D7'). 'Drie van die vrae' does not claim these are the only three. 'Eerste' here is an ordinal, not a superlative.

items.bewering: Die tweede vraag is wat naby daardie plek lê, soos 'n rivier of 'n pad.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Location' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/location/): relative location is how a place is related to other places around it; National Geographic Education, 'Map': maps show the arrangement of features in an area. Wikipedia 'Planimetrics' names roads and rivers as standard map features.

items.bewering: Die derde vraag is watter rigting jy moet volg om daar te kom.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/): a compass rose or arrow on a map shows directions, and a single arrow usually points north.

items.bewering: Daar is baie soorte kaarte, en hulle wys nie almal dieselfde ding nie.
items.bron: Afrikaanse Wikipedia, 'Kaart' (https://af.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kaart): topografiese teenoor tematiese kaarte (bv. bevolkingsdigtheid, klimaat), geografiese teenoor skematiese kaarte, grootskaal teenoor kleinskaal; National Geographic Education, 'Map'.

items.bewering: 'n Wêreldkaart, 'n kontinentkaart en 'n stadskaart is drie van daardie soorte.
items.bron: National Geographic Education, 'Map' (https://education.nationalgeographic.org/resource/map/): 'A map of a larger area, such as a whole continent or the entire world, is called a small-scale map', against 'a neighborhood street map', which is a large-scale map. All three kinds exist and differ in the area and detail they show.

items.bewering: Jy kies elke keer die kaart wat by jou eie vraag pas.
items.bron: ITC Living Textbook, 'Cartographic generalization' (https://ltb.itc.utwente.nl/659/concept/174062): what a map shows depends on its scale and purpose, so a small-scale map shows only major cities while a large-scale map shows roads and landmarks; National Geographic Education, 'Map'. This is advice rather than a fact claim, and it follows from that.

items.bewering: kaart: 'n Verkleinde tekening wat van bo af wys waar dinge in 'n plek lê.
items.bron: Same sources as the definition in 'Wat 'n kaart is': National Geographic Education, 'Map'; Afrikaanse Wikipedia, 'Kaart'; Esri GIS Dictionary, 'planimetric map'. The glossary entry repeats the study-block definition word for word, so it is true when read alone. No Afrikaans dictionary entry (VivA, WAT) could be reached online to compare its wording; the meaning is settled by the sources above.

opsomming: Every claim in this short introductory lesson held up against non-textbook reference sources (National Geographic Education, Afrikaans Wikipedia, Esri, the ITC cartography textbook). The lesson has no superlatives ('eerste', 'tweede' and 'derde' are ordinals) and no analogies, only the clinic example. The one nuance, which needs no repair: 'daarom' gives lack of space as the reason mapmakers choose what to show, while purpose is a reason too; the third block carries purpose, so the overall picture is not false.
